title: Analysis of the influence of skin type and other parameters on objective perfusion parameters of the skin and mucosa, identified with spectral optical imaging
summary: Perfusion changes can be early symptoms of various pathologies (e.g. Infection, tumor). It is challenging to correctly detect and interpret changes. Within this sutdy we want to investigate the perfusion of different skin sites and the oral mucosa in healthy volunteers to generate normal values und to detect differences regarding age, sex and skin type. These knowledge can probably help to interpret pathologic alterations in future investigations.

interventions.name: Fotodocumentation of different sites of the outer skin or oral mucosa with hyperspectral imaging in healthy volunteers - single documentation, 20 minutes

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients able to consent
Exclusion criteria:
Intraoral disease
prior radiation of the head and neck
